front.title: A Policy-Driven Implicit TLS Transport Profile for PCEP

abstract.t: RFC 8253 specifies the use of Transport Layer Security (TLS) for the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) by negotiating TLS using the PCEP StartTLS message exchange. This document specifies a deployment profile in which TLS is initiated immediately after TCP connection establishment, on the existing PCEP port, based on an out- of-band configured policy. This profile is intended for managed deployments where TLS is mandatory and neither in-band security-mode negotiation nor fallback to cleartext is permitted.
